svg.title: Sourcing Workload Benchmarks
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-sourcing-workload-benchmarks; chapter number: 4; title: Sourcing Workload Benchmarks; subtitle: What a consistent on- and off-market deal funnel looks like; chart type: stacked_comparison; total range: 10-20 minutes a day feeding 50-100 reviewed deals and 30-50 NDAs; buckets: label: Deals Reviewed; low: 50; high: 100; notes: Codie Sanchez's review target across listings and off-market targets.; label: NDAs Signed; low: 30; high: 50; notes: LOIs go out on about 20%; reject anything under a 15% margin first.; label: Qualified Seller Meetings per Month; low: 5; high: 10; notes: CGS Partners search fund, Illinois and Indiana specialty distribution and HVAC, via calls, LinkedIn and email.; label: Daily Minutes on the Funnel; low: 10; high: 20; notes: Worked consistently rather than in bursts.; caption: Practitioner benchmarks for the reviewing, NDA and meeting volume behind a sourcing engine that reaches owners before anyone else does.; assumptions note: Buckets carry different units (deals, NDAs, meetings per month, minutes per day) and are compared side by side, not summed.; note: Attributed to Codie Sanchez (3mtS8rOAqoM at 00:42:09 and 01:13:51) and Marco Palmero (iPMw4FjbyRQ at 00:02:48).
